messages.subject: Letter Before Action - Sutherland Logistics / Vantage Freight
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We act for Sutherland Logistics Limited. Please find attached a letter before action concerning the Logistics Services Agreement dated 12 January 2023. The letter requires a response within 21 days.

We should be grateful if you would confirm safe receipt and let us know whether you have instructed solicitors.

Yours faithfully,
Tom Gallagher
for Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
